title: Bright light over Catalina identified as the ISS

tellings.quote: And then we discovered that that bright light was the space station.

plain: During a 2021 field mission over the Catalina Channel off California, a team of scientists watching the sky for unexplained objects saw a bright light, and then "discovered that that bright light was the space station". The physicist Kevin Knuth, who was there with the physicist Matthew Szydagis, tells Michels this, and says the mission was written up in a scientific paper. He gives it as an example of a sighting that turned out to have an ordinary explanation.
